control_flow: followInTheDark: if the right light is below 60 %, check the line tracker; else call avoidWalls.
Right light below 60 %: line tracker below 90 % curves left, above 95 % curves right, else calls avoidWalls.
avoidWalls: if the left light is below 70 %, turn right at an obstacle on the left, turn left at one on the right, else call driveInTheDark; if the left light is 70 % or more, call driveInTheDark.
driveInTheDark: if the left light is below 70 %, drive forward; else call stopAtWall.
stopAtWall: if an obstacle is ahead, stop; else call followLine.
followLine: black under the line tracker curves left, otherwise curves right.

likely_intent.description: In the dark, follow a black line when one is under the robot and drive straight when there is none; in the light, follow the line as before.
